summary: Owned units, claims, hints, and people were checked against the Chinese chapter, not the English rendering. Stated ages (five sui undated; twenty-three sui at death) are preserved, and no birth year was inferred from them. Hui’s accession, Yuankang 1, Yongkang 1, Yongning 1, and Tai’an 1 convert to AD 290, 291, 300, 301, and 302. The twelfth month after 九年六月 is Yuankang 9/12, which the calendar tables place entirely in AD 300 (month begins 300-01-08), so those deposition dates are not the conventional 299 reign-year label. Empty hints on undated and retrospective figures were left empty. Posthumous 追封/追諡 remain reception and do not feed extra activity years. Competing annals readings (burial 己卯 versus 壬寅; Shang’s heirship August versus May) stay same-year witnesses. No owned check is unsupported.

evidence.quote: 故臣江統、陸機並作誄頌焉

personChecks.reason: Zang has no birth date. Living dates are Yongkang 1 enfeoffment and heirship, then Yongning 1 degradation and murder. The 太安初 追諡 is reception and is kept out of hints.

evidence.quote: 永康元年四月，封臨淮王

personChecks.reason: Shang has no birth date. Enfeoffment AD 300, heirship AD 301, death 太安元年三月癸卯 AD 302. The chapter’s 八月 heirship and the annals’ May dating compete on month, not year.

evidence.quote: 永康元年四月，封為襄陽王
永寧元年八月，立為皇太孫

personChecks.reason: Prince Jian is only a historian’s comparison. Retrospective classification and empty hints keep that line off his life dates.
Crown Prince Li is only the Liyuan comparison. No Han life year is imported.
The Elder of Huguan is only a condolence allusion; empty hints and the undated attestation are required.
Qianqiu is the paired condolence allusion; no life date is stated or invented.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 太熙元年四月己酉，武帝崩。是日，皇太子即皇帝位
references.reason: Primary Jin Shu annals date Hui’s accession, the event compressed in s0201 as 惠帝即位, to Taixi 1, AD 290.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 秋八月壬午，立廣陵王遹爲皇太子
references.reason: Annals place Yu’s heirship in the eighth month of the accession year; still AD 290, so s0201’s year conversion holds.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 十二月壬戌，廢皇太子遹爲庶人
references.reason: Annals confirm the chapter’s twelfth-month deposition as Yuankang 9/12, day renxu.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 癸未，賈后矯詔害庶人遹于許昌
references.reason: Annals give a guiwei day inside Yongkang 1/3 for Yu’s murder; the chapter’s 三月 year is still AD 300.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 六月壬寅，葬愍懷太子于顯平陵
references.reason: Competing burial day: annals write 壬寅 against the biography’s 己卯. Both sit in Yongkang 1/6, AD 300; the day conflict is preserved.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.reason: Annals date Bin’s death to Yongkang 1/1, day bingzi, confirming s0171’s AD 300 year.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 己亥，趙王倫矯詔害賈庶人于金墉城。
references.reason: Annals place Jia’s death in Yongkang 1/4, supporting s0131’s AD 300 anchor for the executions and restoration.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 永寧元年春正月乙丑，趙王倫篡帝位
references.reason: Annals use 永寧元年正月 for Lun’s usurpation, matching s0183’s 永甯元年正月 as AD 301.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 五月，立襄陽王尚爲皇太孫
references.reason: Annals date Shang’s heirship to Yongning 1/5 against the biography’s 八月. The year remains AD 301; the month conflict is preserved.

references.title: 晉書/卷004
references.quote: 三月癸卯，赦司、冀、兗、豫四州。皇太孫尚薨。
references.reason: Annals repeat 太安元年三月癸卯 for Shang’s death, the civil year Jin Shu labels Tai’an 1, AD 302.

references.title: 太熙 (Wikipedia)
references.quote: 太熙元年四月，晋武帝逝世，晋惠帝司马衷即位，改元永熙元年。
references.reason: Calendar page for Taixi places Hui’s accession in AD 290, the conversion used for 惠帝即位.

references.title: 元康 (西晋)
references.quote: 元康十年（300年）正月一日，改元為永康元年。
references.reason: Yuankang ends at New Year AD 300. The same page’s month table starts 元康九年十二月 on 300/1/8, so the chapter’s 十二月 events are AD 300, not the conventional 299 reign-year label. Western year-level values here do not flip between Julian and proleptic Gregorian.

references.title: 永康 (西晋)
references.quote: 永康（ 300年—301年四月）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第四个年号。
references.reason: Yongkang 1 is AD 300. The page table places 正月 on 2/7, 三月 on 4/6, and 六月 on 7/3, all inside AD 300, supporting 明年正月, the March murder, and the sixth-month burial.

references.title: 永宁 (西晋)
references.quote: 永宁（ 301年四月—302年十一月）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第五个年号
references.reason: Yongning corresponds to AD 301–302. 永甯/永寧元年正月 and 八月 therefore convert to AD 301.

references.title: 太安 (西晋)
references.quote: 永寧二年（302年）十二月二十二日，改元為太安元年。
references.reason: Tai’an was proclaimed in the twelfth month of Yongning 2, but Jin Shu headings treat 太安元年 as the civil year AD 302, so 太安元年三月 and 太安初 stay AD 302.

references.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
references.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
references.reason: Academia Sinica defaults to Julian before 1582-10-15. For these AD 290–302 months the Western year is the same under that default and proleptic Gregorian; claims here use year precision, not a converted day.
